query: SELECT t.source_version_id AS "id!" FROM ( SELECT source_version_id FROM manifestation_genres WHERE manifestation_id = $1 UNION SELECT source_version_id FROM manifestation_moods WHERE manifestation_id = $1 UNION SELECT source_version_id FROM manifestation_tags WHERE manifestation_id = $1 UNION SELECT source_version_id FROM work_authors WHERE work_id = $2 ) t WHERE t.source_version_id IS NOT NULL
